author: Jennifer Salazar
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Insider Sells $903,916.26 in Stock
text:
Posted by Jennifer Salazar on Jun 21st, 2018 // No Comments
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) insider Luca Maestri sold 4,769 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, June 1st. The shares were sold at an average price of $189.54, for a total value of $903,916.26. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 68,044 shares in the company, valued at $12,897,059.76. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at the SEC website .
Luca Maestri also recently made the following trade(s): Get Apple alerts: On Friday, April 13th, Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of Apple stock. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52.
AAPL stock opened at $186.50 on Thursday. The firm has a market cap of $957.67 billion, a P/E ratio of 20.25, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.55 and a beta of 1.29. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $142.28 and a fifty-two week high of $194.20. The company has a quick ratio of 1.37, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 39.97% and a net margin of 21.55%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period last year, the firm earned $2.10 EPS. equities research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Apple announced that its board has approved a stock buyback plan on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization permits the iPhone maker to purchase up to 11.9% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares repurchase plans are often a sign that the company’s board believes its shares are undervalued.
Several research firms recently weighed in on AAPL. Atlantic Securities reissued a “neutral” rating and set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, May 2nd. UBS Group set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Wednesday, June 13th. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Friday, June 8th. BMO Capital Markets upped their target price on Apple from $166.00 to $171.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a research report on Wednesday, May 2nd. Finally, Barclays upped their target price on Apple from $157.00 to $161.00 and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Wednesday, May 2nd. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have assigned a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $206.89.
Several hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple in the 1st quarter worth $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC bought a new position in Apple during the first quarter worth about $134,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC bought a new position in Apple during the first quarter worth about $138,000. Macroview Investment Management LLC lifted its holdings in Apple by 220.3% during the first quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $151,000 after acquiring an additional 619 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Oak Point Wealth Management bought a new position in Apple during the fourth quarter worth about $163,000. 58.04% of the stock is owned by institutional investors.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide.
